author: Evan_Usa

title: Marvelous!
text: The whole experience was amazing from the beginning of the drive from Granada to Cordoba! Jose (driver) made us comfortable that we didn’t feel like meeting him for the first time or like a stranger. He was flexible and super knowledgeable about the whole tour, history of Granada, Cordoba, and anything in between. He provided great insights into Cordoba by touring inside the city. The guide in the mosque was very knowledgeable and provided great insights into the history, architecture, & construction! Definitely recommend the tour to anyone. The whole tour comfortable, flexible, and superb!
author: Miki_P

title: A Wonderful Day Exploring Córdoba with Gonzalo
text:
Gonzalo was an excellent guide for our trip to Córdoba and the Mezquita-Cathedral. He shared fascinating stories and explained the history in a very engaging way. He answered all our questions and made the visit truly special.
He was friendly, knowledgeable, attentive, and great company throughout the day. Visiting the Mezquita-Cathedral was an amazing experience, and Gonzalo made it even more memorable. We highly recommend this trip and Gonzalo as your guide! :)
author: KarolS148

title: High value daytrip to Cordoba
text: The day visit to the Mezquita was outstanding. Jose, our driver and guide, was so knowledgeable about the countryside and Cordoba. The visit to the area,  mosque and cathedral is worth every cent.
author: C858HQsallyc

title: Cordoba
text: We wish we had left Granada earlier in the morning so that we could have attended more patios during the patio festival before the siesta.  The Mosque tour was wonderful too.  We just wish we had more time in this charming town.
author: Margaret_H

title: Wonderful day in Cordoba
text: The day was beautiful from start to finish. Our driver, Jose, was very friendly, helpful, informative and accommodating.  We were a group of four and everyone was extremely pleased with the trip. The guide at the Mezquita was also outstanding.
author: Scott_S

title: Great driver & tour guide and a charming Cordoba visit
text: The Mezquita is a must see if you are in the area. Gonzalo was an informative and friendly driver - we enjoyed seeing several of the famous, award winning patios in town prior to meeting up with Isabel who gave the Mesquita tour. Long but very enjoyable day. Highly recommend this tour.
